sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Microbiology (CODE: MI) table read at text offsets 290000-390000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that mostly restated rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level is SH or P; knowledge mode otherwise. No exceptions needed.
scope: All 69 Microbiology references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (MI1.1-MI11.3; MI3.2, MI3.5, MI3.6 and MI4.7 already reviewed).
observations: The official text prints the MI8.3 code as "MI 8." with the minor digit missing; MI8.3 (syndromic management of STIs) is absent from the names-only index, consistent with a malformed-token source exception. Not reviewed here.
Topic 10 header lists one certifiable competency; only MI10.3 shows a number.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, laboratory, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
Programme and reference-centre names not checked for currency.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
certificationCountReported values are reader-reported and need a rendered-page check before use.

rows.note: Official row differentiates malignant from benign malaria on smear or serology; draft adds the limits of serology in acute diagnosis. Scope retained.
